description: This file defines the SuiteEditorSettingsForTinyMCE class, which configures TinyMCE editor settings within the SuiteCRM project. It extends SuiteEditorSettingsForDirectHTML and initializes TinyMCE configuration in its constructor.

classes.name: SuiteEditorSettingsForTinyMCE
classes.description: A class that extends SuiteEditorSettingsForDirectHTML to configure TinyMCE editor settings using configurations from SugarTinyMCE.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class, calls parent constructor, includes SugarTinyMCE, and sets up TinyMCE configuration as JSON.
